title: Weight geometry governs functional memory in complex systems
summary: Complex systems, from gene regulatory networks to neural circuits and ecological food webs, exhibit rich functional behaviour that topology alone does not capture. Yet functional complexity remains difficult to quantify independently of structural organisation. Here we introduce a thermodynamic framework in which functional complexity is characterised through the hierarchical organisation of functional memory, quantifying how the influence of past interactions is distributed and progressively compressed across scales.
